name: peer
description: An agent harness for learning: adaptive teaching, practice, and a persistent knowledge graph.

scripts.dev: npm run plugins:build-core && npm run plugins:build-authoring && npm run client:build && concurrently -k "node scripts/client-build.mjs --watch" "PORT=${PORT:-3000} HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1 tsx watch src/api/main.ts"
scripts.build: npm run plugins:build-core && npm run plugins:build-authoring && npm run client:build && node scripts/build-server.mjs
scripts.test:substrate: NODE_ENV=test PEER_REQUIRE_SUBSTRATE=1 ./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test tests/substrate-foundation.test.ts tests/substrate-native-smoke.test.ts tests/lumberjack-dag-store.test.ts tests/lumberjack-events-objects.test.ts tests/import-learnharness.test.ts tests/import-learnharness-faults.test.ts tests/mfn-unit.test.ts tests/mfn-outbox.test.ts tests/mfn-client.test.ts tests/mfn-context-mapper.test.ts tests/mfn-context-faults.test.ts tests/mfn-chat-handler.test.ts tests/mfn-live-integration.test.ts tests/mfn-live-backup-pause.test.ts
scripts.test:client:e2e: node scripts/client-build.mjs && NODE_ENV=test PEER_E2E=1 ./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/client-e2e-session-readonly.test.ts tests/client-e2e-c2a-flows.test.ts tests/client-e2e-c2b-workspace.test.ts tests/client-e2e-c2c-plugins-voice.test.ts
scripts.desktop:dist: rm -rf dist && npm run build && node scripts/smoke-provider-runtime.mjs && node scripts/smoke-server.mjs --electron && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
